title: Desenvolvedor (a) Kernel Sistemas de Alto Desempenho
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Configuração, compilação e integração do kernel Linux utilizando ferramentas com o Buildroot e Yocto.
  • Implementação de novos device drivers, adaptação de device drivers existentes para novas arquiteturas.
  • Adaptação de bootloaders, como U-Boot e OpenSBI, para novas plataformas e geração da descrição de hardware em mecanismos como device tree.
  • Colaboração com equipes de firmware e hardware para integração de kernel, bootloader, device tree e drivers à uma nova plataforma de hardware.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Bacharelado ou mestrado em Ciência ou Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia Elétrica/Eletrônica ou áreas relacionadas.
  • Proficiência na linguagem C e em assembly, com foco em sistemas de alto desempenho e em desenvolvimento para ambientes sem sistema operacional (bare metal) e em kernel-space.
  • Ao menos 5 anos de experiência com a adaptação (porting) e bring-up do kernel Linux para novos plataformas, e implementação e adaptação de device drivers.
  • Conhecimentos sobre a arquitetura e detalhes de implementação do kernel Linux, como gerenciamento de memória, escalonadores, processos, threads, etc.
  • Experiência com ferramentas para geração de sistemas Linux, como Buildroot e Yocto, e ferramentas de emulação e depuração, como QEMU e GDB.

Desejável:

  • Conhecimentos da arquitetura RISC-V, em especial assembly para RISC-V, processo de boot, Supervisor Binary Interface (SBI), mecanismos de interrupção (CLINT, PLIC, APLIC), modelo de memória, mecanismos de sincronização e operações atômicas.
  • Conhecimento em otimização de desempenho.
  • Ajustes do escalonador, gerenciamento de memória e syscalls (chamadas de sistema) para utilizar os recursos únicos da arquitetura RISC-V.
  • Conhecimentos e experiência com bootloaders e códigos de inicialização: UEFI, U-Boot, EDK II, Open-SBI.
  • Contribuições em projetos de código aberto.
  • Conhecimento em análise e otimização de desempenho.
  • Ajustes do escalonador, gerenciamento de memória e syscalls para utilização dos recursos únicos da arquitetura RISC-V
  • Experiência na caracterização (profiling) de desempenho de aplicações e uso de ferramentas como perf e eBPF.

title: Consultor Planejamento Pl
description:

  • Desejável experiência com softwares de planejamento (MS Project, Primavera;

  • Desejável experiência com planejamento orçamentário, forecast e acompanhamento de performance;
  • Desejável CNH B;
  • Desejável experiência com atividades administrativas ou de análises;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho 100% presencial em São José do Rio Pardo/SP.

O seu dia a dia:

  • Elaborar histogramas de recursos (pessoas, equipamentos e materiais) com base nas demandas de cada obra, contribuindo para a composição orçamentária e a alocação eficiente dos recursos;
  • Construir e atualizar cronogramas físicos das obras a partir da análise de dados técnicos, garantindo o controle dos prazos e o alinhamento com os objetivos do projeto;
  • Desenvolver e manter curvas S e relatórios de acompanhamento para apoiar o monitoramento da evolução física e financeira das obras;
  • Elaborar, acompanhar e revisar orçamentos de obras, consolidando informações técnicas e financeiras para garantir a acurácia e a aderência às metas corporativas;
  • Realizar análises financeiras e operacionais para identificar desvios, riscos e oportunidades, suportando decisões estratégicas da liderança;
  • Consolidar e interpretar dados de múltiplas áreas, transformando informações técnicas e financeiras em relatórios gerenciais estruturados e objetivos;
  • Monitorar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs – Key Performance Indicators) e propor ajustes nos planos e metas para assegurar o cumprimento dos objetivos estratégicos;
  • Contribuir na construção de modelos de planejamento e simulação de cenários, participando do desenvolvimento de projeções de curto, médio e longo prazos;
  • Apoiar o desdobramento de metas e objetivos, garantindo coerência entre os planos operacionais e a estratégia organizacional;
  • Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de finanças, controladoria, operações e comercial para promover consistência e integração entre os dados e os planos corporativos;
  • Colaborar na melhoria contínua de processos, ferramentas e sistemas de planejamento, propondo automatizações e otimizações que aumentem a eficiência das entregas;
  • Preparar apresentações executivas para comitês e diretoria, consolidando dados, análises e recomendações em materiais objetivos e estratégicos;
  • Apoiar projetos estratégicos ou corporativos, conduzindo análises, acompanhando cronogramas e controlando entregas para garantir o atingimento dos resultados esperados.

O que oferecemos:

  • Vale Transporte;
  • Vale Refeição;
  • Vale Alimentação;
  • Assistência Médica;
  • Assistência Odontológica;
  • Licença maternidade 6 meses e paternidade 20 dias
  • Auxílio creche (conforme regras de elegibilidade);
  • Seguro de Vida;
  • PLR;
  • Gympass;
  • Programa Fale Comigo (assessoria gratuita e sigilosa via telefone para auxílio psicológico, jurídico, financeiro, social).

Conheça um pouco sobre nós:

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

Desde 2017, o Grupo faz parte da State Grid, maior empresa de energia elétrica do mundo, fortalecendo a nossa estratégia de crescimento e o protagonismo no setor elétrico brasileiro.

Através das nossas distribuidoras levamos energia para mais de 10 milhões de endereços, o que corresponde a mais de 22 milhões de pessoas atendidas com a eficiência da nossa rede de atendimento.

Acreditamos que equipes plurais e um ambiente inclusivo para todas as pessoas são fundamentais para a sustentabilidade de organizações inovadoras e com foco em clientes, por isso, valorizamos a pluralidade e orientamos nossas ações para garantir uma cultura inclusiva e oportunidades a todas as pessoas.

description:
SDR (Inbound & Outbound)

Mobiis Campinas, São Paulo, Brasil

Sobre a Mobiis

A Mobiis é um ecossistema que conecta soluções SaaS para aumentar a eficiência e impulsionar a inovação na cadeia logística. Resultado da união entre Fretefy e Pathfind, a empresa oferece tecnologias avançadas como TMS, Marketplace de Fretes e APIs, ajudando clientes e parceiros a otimizarem seus processos logísticos com mais inteligência e escala.

Resumo da função

O SDR (Inbound & Outbound) será responsável por atuar na prospecção ativa e no atendimento de leads inbound, qualificando oportunidades para as soluções SaaS da Mobiis. Seu papel é identificar dores, entender o contexto do prospect, gerar interesse e agendar reuniões ou demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas, mantendo um funil de pré-vendas saudável e previsível.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar tanto em outbound (ligações ativas, cadências e prospecção) quanto em inbound (leads vindos de marketing, eventos, formulários e outros canais).
  • Qualificar leads e prospects, entendendo necessidades, desafios, orçamento, perfil decisor e timing.
  • Realizar abordagens consultivas, apresentando de forma objetiva as soluções da Mobiis.
  • Agendar reuniões e demonstrações qualificadas para o time de vendas (closers / executivos de conta).
  • Realizar follow-ups estratégicos ao longo do ciclo inicial de pré-vendas.
  • Registrar e atualizar todas as interações no CRM, garantindo organização e rastreabilidade.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de Marketing e Vendas para melhoria contínua de scripts, discursos e campanhas.
  • Atingir metas mensais de leads qualificados e reuniões agendadas.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia como SDR, Inside Sales ou funções similares, preferencialmente em vendas B2B ou SaaS.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, persuasão e resiliência a objeções.
  • Perfil proativo, organizado e orientado a processos e metas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM e rotina de pré-vendas.
  • Interesse e facilidade para aprender sobre soluções tecnológicas.

Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência com modelos de vendas inbound e outbound.
  • Vivência em empresas de tecnologia, SaaS ou logística.
  • Conhecimento prévio em logística, transporte ou cadeia de suprimentos.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Capacidade de adaptação a metas desafiadoras e ambientes de rápido crescimento.

AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Product Manager , you’ll define strategy, lead teams, and deliver digital products that engage millions of users worldwide. Combining data-driven insights with market knowledge, you’ll shape product vision, mentor peers, and collaborate across functions. This role offers high impact, growth, and the chance to influence the future of digital media .

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Product Strategy – Develop and communicate a clear product strategy and vision for IGN’s digital platforms and products, aligning it with the company’s goals and objectives
  • Product Leadership – Lead multiple product teams and drive product strategy for a larger portfolio of products.
  • Team Leadership – Lead and mentor a team of product managers, providing guidance and support to help them achieve their goals and deliver high-quality products.
  • Product Roadmap – Define and maintain the product roadmap for multiple products, ensuring it aligns with business priorities, user needs, and market trends. Make data-driven decisions and prioritize features accordingly.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, editorial, and marketing, to ensure successful product development and delivery.
  • User Research – Conduct and analyze user research to gain a deep understanding of user needs, preferences, and pain points. Use this data to inform product decisions and improvements.
  • User Experience (UX) – Work with UX/UI designers to create user-friendly and visually appealing products. Ensure a seamless and engaging user experience across IGN’s digital platforms.
  • Data Analysis – Utilize data analytics and key performance indicators (KPIs) to monitor product performance, identify areas for improvement, and make data-driven decisions to optimize the product.
  • Product Development – Oversee the end-to-end product development process, from ideation to release. Coordinate with development teams to deliver high-quality products on schedule.
  • Project Management – Define and prioritize product features, enhancements, and requirements based on customer feedback, market research, and business impact. Collaborate with product managers to ensure that product feature prioritization aligns with the overall product strategy and roadmap.
  • Product Launch – Plan and execute successful product launches, including marketing strategies and user communication. Monitor product performance post-launch and iterate based on user feedback.
  • Stakeholder Communication – Keep stakeholders informed about the status of ongoing projects, milestones, and potential roadblocks. Maintain transparency and ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Market and Competitive Analysis – Stay informed about industry trends, emerging technologies, and the competitive landscape to identify opportunities and threats in the market.
  • User Feedback and Support – Engage with user feedback, reviews, and support channels to address user concerns, gather insights, and drive product improvements.

MUST HAVES
- 5-7 years working on technology-powered products as either a product manager or user researcher;
- Strong understanding of digital media platforms, technologies, and industry trends ;
- Proven ability of build intuitive content management systems that meet both internal and external customer needs;
- Experience in building subscription based products with a track record of driving growth;
- Led product development on complex features from 1st to Nth interaction;
- A history of deep and demonstrated understanding of the techniques and methods of modern product discovery and product delivery;
- Demonstrated ability to figure out solutions to hard problems with many constraints, using sound judgment to assess risks, and to lay out your argument in a well-structured, data-informed, written narrative;
- Proven ability to engage with engineers, designers, and company leaders in a constructive and collaborative relationship;
- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience;
- Upper-Intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- Deep understanding of gaming trends;
- Strong background in app development and design.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

title: Editor Texto e Imagem
description:
Sobre nós

A Evolucional acredita que o uso de dados pode transformar a educação e o processo de aprendizagem. Atuamos, desde 2014, oferecendo simulados e avaliações para escolas em todo o Brasil. A partir disso, geramos dados precisos sobre o conhecimento dos alunos, e ajudamos as instituições de ensino na transformação da gestão pedagógica.

Quais são as funções do cargo?

  • Diagramar provas, simulados e materiais avaliativos conforme identidade visual da instituição.
  • Garantir padronização de estilos, espaçamento, tipografia e hierarquia visual.
  • Preparar arquivos finais para impressão e/ou publicação digital.
  • Realizar ajustes finos em textos, tabelas, imagens e fórmulas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com revisores, designers e autores nos processos de preparação dos instrumentos.
  • Manter e atualizar templates e guias de diagramação.
  • Otimizar processos gráficos visando agilidade e qualidade nas entregas.

O que é preciso para darmos #match

  • Experiência em diagramação editorial, preferencialmente de provas, livros didáticos ou materiais educacionais.
  • Domínio de Adobe InDesign (essencial) e conhecimento de Illustrator, Photoshop e Pacote Office.
  • Conhecimento de normas gráficas e boas práticas de editoração.
  • Atenção aos detalhes, senso estético e excelente organização.
  • Capacidade de lidar com prazos curtos e alto volume de materiais.

Aqui, você vai encontrar um espaço acolhedor, que irá dar oportunidade para que você aprenda e se desenvolva! Fazemos isso por meio de um trabalho em equipe harmonioso, que conta com pessoas qualificadas e abertas a ensinar e aprender, buscando sempre obter os melhores resultados para o time!

Marex Group plc (NASDAQ: MRX) is a diversified global financial services platform providing essential liquidity, market access and infrastructure services to clients across energy, commodities and financial markets.   • Implementar automações que reduzam o tempo de resposta, otimizem o MTTR e fortaleçam a eficiência do SOC;

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table‑top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to support delivery and execution across our Sales Enablement and Frontline experience teams. In this role, you’ll contribute to initiatives that span multiple tools and workflows used by our sales and customer‑facing teams. You'll work closely with senior PMs, designers, engineers, and go‑to‑market partners to help scope, prioritize, and deliver features that improve productivity, consistency, and experience across our frontline ecosystem.

This is a great opportunity for a PM who thrives in cross‑functional, collaborative environments , and who enjoys solving practical product problems that make a real difference for internal users.

What you’ll do:

  • Contribute to the delivery of product initiatives across multiple Sales Enablement tools and workflows
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to clarify scope, define requirements, and drive execution
  • Help manage dependencies across related product areas to ensure smooth delivery
  • Gather feedback and context from internal users to inform feature development
  • Write clear product specs, coordinate timelines, and track progress toward milestones
  • Participate in team rituals and help maintain high delivery standards across squads
  • Communicate updates and risks to relevant stakeholders with clarity and structure

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in any area
  • Experience as a product manager working in cross‑functional software teams
  • Strong collaboration skills and a willingness to support shared goals across multiple teams
  • Ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear steps with defined requirements
  • Strong attention to detail and ownership of day‑to‑day execution
  • Comfort working on internal‑facing tools and balancing user needs with technical constraints
  • A learning mindset and willingness to grow under the guidance of senior product leaders
  • Advanced communication and presentation skills in English

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on internal tools or platforms, especially for sales or frontline teams
  • Familiarity with sales enablement platforms, CRMs, or customer success tooling
  • Solid written and verbal communication skills
  • Exposure to product delivery processes (e.g. agile, sprint planning, release coordination)

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

title: Mid-Level Quality Assurance (QA)
description:
Please note that this role works 100% on-site.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-Level QA professional to work collaboratively within agile teams, participating from the early stages of the development process and actively contributing to the quality of deliveries. We seek someone who understands that quality is not a final phase, but a continuous part of development.

What you'll do:

  • Act as an Agile QA, participating in team ceremonies (refinement, planning, daily, review, and retrospective).
  • Ensure delivery quality from the requirements-gathering phase (shift-left approach).
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated API tests.
  • Support the team in defining clear and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Execute functional, exploratory, and regression tests.
  • Log, track, and manage bugs in a clear, objective, and prioritized manner.
  • Work collaboratively with developers, product, and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s quality processes and practices.

What you'll need:

  • Experience with automated API testing (preferably Rest Assured + Kotlin).
  • Knowledge of BDD (Gherkin, Cucumber).
  • Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals.
  • Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum and/or Kanban).
  • Experience in bug management and use of tools such as Jira, Zephyr (or similar).
  • Ability to analyze requirements and identify quality risks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team.
  • Proactive, organized, and collaborative profile.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with E2E testing or frontend automation.
  • Basic knowledge of CI/CD and test execution in pipelines.
  • Basic knowledge of non-functional testing (performance, security, etc.).
  • Experience with log analysis and support in troubleshooting.
  • Experience testing in mobile or distributed environments.

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

title: Expert Engineer in Verification (UVM/IP/SoC)
description:
Are you willing to participate in the development of a human size growing team?

Aedvices specializes in ICs, FPGAs and embedded systems Front-End Digital Design and Design Verification. We provide flexible solutions to our customers, ranging from turnkey design and verification options to dedicated consulting in design or verification as well as training solutions.

Our customer base spans from large semiconductor groups to small tech startups.

We support a wide range of projects in the automotive, big-data, artificial intelligence and energy sectors, such as the verification of the telemetry system of a Mars probe / Mars tremors or the verification of a System-on-Chip for Bluetooth Low Energy.

To sustain our growth, we are looking for several experienced verification engineers to join the team.

Your main responsibilities

As a key member of the verification team, you will define the verification methodologies and adapt them to the project requirements. You will be responsible for the verification of complex IPs and System-On-Chips, the development of verification environments (SystemVerilog/UVM/other), UVM verification IPs (VIPs), and the writing of verification plans.

You propose improvements to existing flows. You will also have the opportunity to work with colleagues in France and with our partners on innovative approaches and methodologies (formal methods, PSS).

Is the job right for you?

To carry out your missions, you need to master several essential technical topics:

  • Functional verification at IP level and of complex SoC,
  • SystemVerilog testbench and UVM core development,
  • Development of verification plans,
  • AMBA protocols,
  • Embedded software development (C, C++),
  • Knowledge of RTL design languages: VHDL, Verilog,
  • Written and spoken English.

Other skills welcome:

  • Object Oriented Programming,
  • Advanced protocols such as PCIe, CXL, Ethernet, Bluetooth, …
  • ASIC and FPGA design,
  • Scripting (Python).

For an efficient and fruitful collaboration, we expect you to:

  • Have an engineering background or equivalent, and at least 5 years’ experience in verification,
  • Be able to balance perfectionism and pragmatism!
  • Be eager to learn new things, grow your skills and elaborate creative technical solutions,
  • Be able to work in a team,
  • Think “problem solving” and think “out of the box”,
  • And last but not least: be committed to customers’ satisfaction.

What we offer you

  • Continue to develop your expertise with the access of all our training materials,
  • Join a friendly company who share values of Diversity, Conviviality, Technical Expertise and Passion,
  • Benefit from a flexible organization with the possibility of remote work,
  • Full time contract,
  • Additional benefits such as meal voucher and dental health.

Want to join us?

Our recruitment process is simple:

After an initial call, you’ll meet with Agnès, our HR Manager, and Eric, our Verification Technical Director.

If your expectations match ours, the recruitment process concludes with a meeting with Fabio, our Brazil director.

description:
Enfermeiro (a) JR - Hemodinâmica / Hospital Vera Cruz

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi‑intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados: São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Receber o plantão do turno anterior ou agenda do dia;
  • Realizar e planejar o atendimento a ser prestado pelos técnicos;
  • Prestar a assistência a pacientes complexos caso haja necessidade;
  • Realizar sistematização da assistência de enfermagem;
  • Realizar o dimensionamento dos colaboradores assegurando assistência segura e de qualidade.
  • Auxiliar na coleta de dados dos indicadores cirúrgicos.

  • Distribuir tarefas;
  • Atuar diretamente em sala cirúrgica;
  • Realizar os procedimentos de enfermagem ou aqueles pertinentes ao enfermeiro;
  • Demais atividades pertinentes ao Enfermeiro.

Chapter Lead Data Analytics | Personalization

bThis is a on-site position, based in São Paulo (SP) OR Campinas (SP).

bAbout us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

bAbout AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

What you’ll do:

Management routine

  • Manage and lead a high-performance team of Data Analysts and Analytics Engineers (8 to 10 resources).
  • Work with product leaders, engineering, and commercial strategy to form a unified data-driven strategy.
  • Support analysis request prioritization with stakeholders and Data Product Managers (DPMs).
  • Actively balance team leadership efforts with practical development/coding of data products, metrics, and visualizations to drive business.

Technical routine

  • Review to verify that best practices have been followed for high-quality products, recommend appropriate data sources and models, ensuring scalability and high reuse.
  • Drive the business strategy by providing insights into current performance and highlighting areas of opportunity for growth. To do this, conduct advanced data analysis, statistical modeling, and machine learning models to answer specific business questions, extract insights and predictive patterns from large datasets to explain and expose potential opportunities from the data.
  • Develop data sets/schemas consuming data from multiple sources such as internal databases, analysis tools, unstructured sources, and other external sources.
  • Demonstrate a solid understanding of complex data models, data structures, and best practices for data governance to support the data platform team in definitions and executions following best practices appropriate to use cases.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree completed in Information Systems, Data Science and Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Engineering, or other data-related fields, with a strong foundation in Statistics.
  • Prior experience in technical management of Data Analyst or Analytics Engineering teams.
  • Advanced English is mandatory - will work with a global team.
  • Experience with B2B portfolio management would be a big plus .
  • Expertise in database query and reporting tools (SQL + Power BI + DAX).
  • Effective skills in programming languages (Python, PySpark, SQL).
  • Strong experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, using Git for code versioning, and actively participating in code review practices.
  • Strong experience with relational (SQL) and non-relational (NoSQL) database technologies.
  • Prior experience in cloud data solutions (e.g., Databricks , Redshift, BigQuery, Teradata, Snowflake) and cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.
  • Experience in analyzing data to identify key insights, gaps, and inconsistencies.
  • Familiarity with the Systems Development Life Cycle and Agile Methodology.

Soft Skills:

  • Effectively communicate complex technical concepts and analytical insights to non-technical stakeholders and senior leadership.
  • Promote collaboration and a productive work environment by sharing knowledge and experience with direct subordinates.
  • Proven ability to seek unconventional solutions, explore opportunities, and develop innovative solutions.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

bEqual Opportunity & Affinitive Action:

AB InBev Growth Group is proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affinitive Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon of race, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

The following fields are optional, but anticipate the information for your registration*.

Remember: your data will never be used as elimination criteria in selection processes. With them, AB InBev Growth Group is able to analyze diversity and reduce biases in selection processes. We want to contribute to changing this reality by being an inclusive company.

title: Product Manager - Search
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the role

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the Search product within the BEES app. Search is a critical capability for BEES, powering most product findability flows and directly impacting GMV across multiple markets. This role sits within the BEES Core team, responsible for building scalable, reliable, and reusable capabilities that serve multiple BEES platforms (Customer, Force, and Link).

You will work closely with engineering, data, design, and multiple product teams to evolve our search algorithms, infrastructure, and user experience, ensuring high performance, reliability, and relevance at scale.

What you'll do

  • Own the product strategy and execution for the Search domain, ensuring high availability, relevance, and performance across countries;
  • Act as a bridge between product and engineering, translating business needs into clear, well-defined epics, features, and technical requirements;
  • Lead backlog refinement, breaking down epics into actionable stories in collaboration with engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with multiple BEES product teams, as Search powers product lists with impacts across various value streams in the apps;
  • Closely monitor search performance and health metrics per country, proactively identifying and addressing issues;
  • Define and validate feature acceptance criteria, ensuring quality before production releases;
  • Leverage data to drive decisions, using existing dashboards and building new analyses when needed;
  • Drive the evolution of search capabilities, including relevance tuning, commercial indicators, and future AI and natural language search initiatives;
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders, presenting updates and insights to senior leadership.

What you'll need

  • University degree in a field related to the role;
  • Experience as a Product Manager working on technical, platform, or backend-heavy products, preferably in technology-driven companies;
  • Strong understanding of search systems, algorithms, or highly scalable backend services (hands-on experience is a plus, but not mandatory);
  • Ability to comfortably communicate with engineers, understanding both backend and frontend concepts and trade-offs;
  • Experience working with data to analyze product performance, identify issues, and support decision-making;
  • Experience working in cross-functional and highly collaborative environments;
  • Familiarity with Agile product development practices;
  • Advanced English skills (written and spoken), with the ability to present and communicate with global stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience with search, ranking, personalization, or recommendation systems;
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (especially Azure);
  • Experience working on core or platform products that serve multiple applications or teams.

What We Offer

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance

Conduct Rules

You must:

Company Values

Salário competitivo, Auxílio Refeição, Carro Ferramenta, Convênio Médico e Odontológico, Gympass, Seguro de Vida, Previdência Privada, PLR, Programa de Treinamentos Internos, Programa de Desenvolvimento e Trilha de Carreira, entre outros

title: Product Manager - Seller Tools
description:
Please note that this role works 100% on‑site.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business‑to‑business (B2B), direct‑to‑consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on‑demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

As a Product Manager for Seller Tools, you will drive the evolution of our ecosystem of tools, ensuring it is both user‑centric and technically sound. You’ll blend strong product expertise (discovery, prioritization, roadmap, UX focus) with technical depth (services, APIs, architecture, data) to deliver scalable, high‑performing solutions.

You’ll act as the connector between commercial operations, end‑users, and engineering, shaping tools that improve partner autonomy, streamline workflows, optimize execution, and unlock new opportunities through data and AI.

What you’ll do:

  • Ownership of end to end Seller Tools, from discovery to execution to adoption;
  • Lead discovery processes to identify user pain points, market gaps, and opportunities for improving workflows;
  • Define product roadmaps that align with business objectives and technical architecture;
  • Collaborate deeply with engineering and architecture teams, understanding APIs, data flows, and service dependencies to make informed product decisions;
  • Balance short‑term feature delivery with long‑term scalability and system health;
  • Translate operational and market needs into clear, technically feasible requirements;
  • Partner with Design to ensure intuitive, operator‑friendly experiences;
  • Define success metrics for features, monitor adoption, and iterate based on data insights;
  • Leverage data to drive prioritization, experimentation, and continuous improvement;
  • Lead efforts to design, integrate, and scale AI‑driven solutions across the product ecosystem;
  • Act as the voice of the customer and operator, while ensuring alignment with system capabilities and architectural vision.

What you’ll need:

  • University degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related area (or equivalent experience);
  • Years of product management experience in enterprise tools, SaaS, or related domains;
  • Strong product expertise in discovery, prioritization, roadmap definition, and UX improvements;
  • Data‑centric mindset, with experience using analytics tools (e.g., Segment, Mixpanel, Databricks, Looker, Tableau, or similar) to drive decisions;
  • Technical knowledge of APIs, microservices, cloud‑based tools, and system integrations (able to discuss trade‑offs with engineers);
  • Experience working with both frontend and backend development teams;
  • Demonstrated experience designing or integrating AI/ML features into existing products;
  • Proficiency with product management tools such as Jira and Confluence;
  • Strong understanding of Scrum and agile workflows;
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both technical and business‑focused.

More about you:

  • You’re passionate about software development and know how to ensure its quality;
  • You’re motivated by building world‑class solutions that impact millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment that uses and stimulates a DevOps culture;
  • You’re creative when solving problems and are continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

What We Offer:

  • Attendance bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance
  • Language and training platforms

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and table top keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the Role

We are looking for a Mid-Level QA professional to work collaboratively within agile teams, participating from the early stages of the development process and actively contributing to the quality of deliveries. We seek someone who understands that quality is not a final phase, but a continuous part of development.

What you'll do:

  • Act as an Agile QA, participating in team ceremonies (refinement, planning, daily, review, and retrospective).
  • Ensure delivery quality from the requirements-gathering phase (shift-left approach).
  • Create, execute, and maintain automated API tests.
  • Support the team in defining clear and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Execute functional, exploratory, and regression tests.
  • Log, track, and manage bugs in a clear, objective, and prioritized manner.
  • Work collaboratively with developers, product, and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s quality processes and practices.

What you'll need:

  • Experience with automated API testing (preferably Rest Assured + Kotlin).
  • Knowledge of BDD (Gherkin, Cucumber).
  • Solid understanding of software testing fundamentals.
  • Experience with agile methodologies (Scrum and/or Kanban).
  • Experience in bug management and use of tools such as Jira, Zephyr (or similar).
  • Ability to analyze requirements and identify quality risks.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a team.
  • Proactive, organized, and collaborative profile.

Nice to Have

  • Advanced communication skills in English (written and spoken);
  • Experience with E2E testing or frontend automation.
  • Basic knowledge of CI/CD and test execution in pipelines.
  • Basic knowledge of non-functional testing (performance, security, etc.).
  • Experience with log analysis and support in troubleshooting.
  • Experience testing in mobile or distributed environments.

More about you:

  • You´re passionate about software development and knows how to ensure its quality;
  • You´re motivated by building up world class solutions that impacts millions of users all over the world;
  • Experienced working in an environment which uses and stimulates DevOps culture;
  • You´re creative when solving problems and is continuously seeking improvements for processes and solutions;
  • You can communicate clearly with your team and the company to identify issues and demands;
  • You have the autonomy to recognize the current and new priorities, evaluating the impact of their outcomes in the final result.

Descrição da vaga

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 Leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3 e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Além disso, realizamos também a aquisição da Casa de Saúde Campinas, um dos hospitais mais importantes da história da cidade, localizado em um prédio centenário, parte do acervo arquitetônico da cidade. Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Para isso, conta com um sistema de saúde completo com hospitais de alta complexidade, laboratórios de exames, planos de saúde e centros médicos.

Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

CONTEXTO E DESCRIÇÃO DO PROJETO:

A AVSI Brasil é uma organização da sociedade civil, sem fins lucrativos, criada em 2007, que atua com foco na melhoria das condições de vida de pessoas em situação de vulnerabilidade. Trabalha em parceria com atores da cooperação internacional, setor público e iniciativa privada. Vinculada à Fundação AVSI, ONG italiana atuante no Brasil desde os anos 1980, tem como missão promover o protagonismo das pessoas em seu desenvolvimento, de suas famílias e comunidades. Implementa projetos sociais com base em uma metodologia de desenvolvimento integral e solidário, voltada à autonomia e à dignidade humana.

Os projetos de eficiência energética realizam ações em comunidades baixa renda, além de beneficiar clientes residenciais com redução da conta de energia, através do uso seguro e mais eficiente da energia elétrica. description:
Assessoria de Investimentos: Começo de carreira | Campinas

A XP Inc. é uma das maiores instituições financeiras independente do Brasil, dona das marcas XP, Rico, Clear, XP Educação, InfoMoney, entre outras. Com mais de 4,6 milhões de clientes ativos e um valor superior a R$ 1,1 trilhão de ativos sob custódia, há 24 anos vem transformando o mercado financeiro para melhorar a vida das pessoas.

Com uma cultura marcante guiada por quatro valores - Sonho Grande, Espírito Empreendedor, Foco no Cliente e Mente Aberta - a XP Inc. está sempre em busca dos melhores talentos que tem ambição de fazer o impossível.

Sobre a Oportunidade

Na XP Inc., acreditamos que nosso time é a chave para o sucesso. Procuramos profissionais em início de carreira, apaixonados pelo mercado financeiro, que compartilhem nossos valores: foco no cliente, espírito empreendedor, mente aberta e sonho grande.

Esta é uma oportunidade única para quem deseja iniciar sua trajetória como Assessor(a) de Investimentos nas marcas XP Investimentos e Rico. Valorizamos pessoas com perfil comercial, que se destacam no relacionamento interpessoal e são movidas pela busca de resultados consistentes.
Aqui, você terá todo o suporte para uma rápida integração e consolidação de seu novo escopo em assessoria, desenvolvendo e aprimorando habilidades de comunicação, aprofundamento nos produtos de financeiros e principalmente, uma imersão no dia a dia do mercado financeiro. Além disso, o programa conta com uma esteira robusta de carreira.

  • Perfil comercial e fortes habilidades de comunicação;
  • Alto nível de intensidade e disciplina para contato online com clientes;
  • Noções básicas de macroeconomia e atualidades;
  • Morar na cidade de Campinas, pois se trata de uma posição no modelo 100% presencial
  • Graduação superior cursando (a partir do 5º semestre) ou completa;
  • Se ainda estiver na faculdade, é necessário estar em um curso noturno;
  • Se identificar com a nossa cultura;

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento sobre produtos financeiros (RF, RV, fundos e outros);
  • CPA-20 ou CEA (Caso o candidato aprovado não tenha a certificação do CPA-20, fornecemos o curso de forma gratuita, em parceria com a Academia Rafael Toro)

Desafios e Impacto

  • Atuação no segmento de Assessoria de Investimentos, sendo responsável por aconselhar e auxiliar a gestão de patrimônio dos clientes;
  • Elaboração de portfólio de investimentos em linha com o perfil e objetivo dos clientes;
  • Análise de alocações externas, elaboração de estudos comparativos exclusivos e identificando oportunidades;
  • Acompanhamento de tendências de mercado, se mantendo sempre informado sobre atualidades do cenário econômico;
  • Disciplina para manter um alta frequência de contato com clientes de forma online e presencial.
    *Obs.: a contratação é CLT.

Triagem inicial : Análise do currículo para verificar a adequação às qualificações e requisitos da vaga.

Testes gerais : Avaliação do alinhamento cultural com o teste da Mindsight e teste de raciocínio lógico da Predictive Index.

Dinâmica e/ou entrevista com a equipe de Recrutamento : Dinâmica avaliando habilidades específicas necessárias para a função ou discussão sobre as expectativas em relação à vaga e aos objetivos profissionais.

Entrevista com a liderança : Uma conversa para discutir sua visão e como você pode contribuir para a equipe e a empresa.

  • Etapa de case: Onde você poderá demonstrar sua visão estratégica e tomada de decisão na construção de soluções para um cliente.

Entrevista com Head Comercial : Conversa para discutir sobre o seu perfil e características necessárias para contribuir com a operação

Entrevista focada em cultura : Exploração dos valores e princípios da empresa para garantir um bom encaixe cultural.

Oferta : Apresentação da proposta de trabalho, incluindo detalhes sobre remuneração e benefícios.

Saúde e bem-estar:

  • Plano de saúde sem coparticipação (inclusive, para dependentes)
  • iFood Benefícios (VA e VR flexível)
  • Licença parental: maternidade de 6 meses e paternidade de 20 dias.
  • Auxílio Creche

Vida Financeira

  • Assessoria de Investimentos
  • Cartão XP Visa Infinite sem anuidade
  • Crédito (consignado, home equity, CCB Imobiliário, etc.)

Modelo de Trabalho Presencial Flexível

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função, podendo ser totalmente presencial para frentes de negócio e mais flexível para outras equipes.
Seguimos um modelo com mais frequência presencial, mas sempre guiado por flexibilidade e autonomia com a responsabilidade da nossa cultura empreendedora.

Aqui na XP Inc., valorizamos as interações pessoais e acreditamos no uso do escritório como uma ferramenta para potencializar nossas relações no trabalho.

About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.
  • Building and managing product roadmaps, aligning them with strategic goals while balancing stakeholder priorities.
  • Acting as the voice of the customer, identifying pain points, and advocating for user‑centric solutions.
  • Collaborating with engineering, design, data science, and commercial teams to define requirements and deliver value.
  • Using data and metrics to drive decision‑making, develop business cases, and measure success.
  • Writing detailed business requirements and user stories for clear communication with the development team.
  • Engaging in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, retrospectives, and reviews, to ensure iterative and incremental progress.
  • Monitoring and communicating product performance, identifying areas for improvement, and implementing solutions.
  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You’ll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium‑to‑large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross‑functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with a customer‑centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem‑solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high‑quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user‑centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.

What We Offer:

  • Performance based bonus*
  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance*

description:
About the job: Quality Assurance Engineer

Quality Assurance Engineer (QA) with TypeScript and Node.js

Position Overview

As a Quality Assurance Engineer at The Methodical Group, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and usability of our applications built on TypeScript and Node.js foundations. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including developers, product managers, and designers, to deliver high-quality software solutions that meet our clients' needs and exceed their expectations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test Planning and Strategy: Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test strategies based on project requirements and specifications. Identify testing objectives, scope, and priorities to ensure thorough test coverage.
  • Test Execution: Execute manual and automated tests to verify the functionality, performance, and security of web applications built on TypeScript and Node.js. Conduct regression testing, smoke testing, and exploratory testing as needed.
  • Defect Management: Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects using issue tracking systems. Collaborate with development teams to investigate and resolve issues in a timely manner.
  • Automation Testing: Develop and maintain automated test scripts using testing frameworks and libraries specific to TypeScript and Node.js. Continuously enhance test automation frameworks to improve efficiency and reliability.
  • Quality Assurance Processes: Participate in continuous improvement initiatives to enhance QA processes, tools, and methodologies. Contribute to the development and adoption of best practices for software quality assurance.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with software developers, product managers, and other stakeholders to clarify requirements, provide feedback on design and functionality, and ensure alignment with quality standards.
  • Documentation: Create and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test cases, test reports, and other relevant artifacts. Ensure that documentation is accurate, up-to-date, and accessible to team members.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven experience in quality assurance/testing of web applications, preferably using TypeScript and Node.js technologies.
  • Solid understanding of software testing principles, methodologies, and best practices.
  • Proficiency in test automation using testing frameworks/tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.
  • Experience with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban) is a plus.
  • Knowledge of continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools is desirable.

Por que Lesaffre? Na Lesaffre, cada colaborador desempenha um papel significativo em nossa visão de reinvenção por meio da fermentação. Aqui, você fará parte de uma organização global com mais de 170 anos de história, comprometida com a inovação, a sustentabilidade e a criação de valor para nossos clientes e parceiros ao redor do mundo.

title: Digital Talent | Bosch Global
description:
How Bosch is training the smartest minds

In the race to secure the best digital talent, Bosch is setting up the “Digital Talent Academy” in Brazil. It trains young people in areas such as software development and artificial intelligence. For many of them, this represents a decisive step toward a different life.

The red logotype is already recognizable from the freeway. Huge letters spelling out BOSCH adorn the main building of the Campinas location in Brazil. Nicolly Cristina Cruz Storoni had often driven past here with her mother. She had never imagined that she could ever work for the company with the red logo. But two years ago, her dream unexpectedly became reality. In July 2021, the then 17-year-old applied for a place at Bosch’s newly established Digital Talent Academy (DTA) in Campinas and prevailed over more than 2,000 candidates. She was among the top 18 who were offered a place in that year’s round of admissions.

Since summer 2021, Nicolly has been studying and working at the Digital Talent Academy at the Bosch location in Campinas, Brazil

My biggest wish is to finish my apprenticeship, buy my own apartment and car, and develop professionally in my career.

YouTube

Loading the video requires your consent. If you agree by clicking on the Play icon, the video will load and data will be transmitted to Google as well as information will be accessed and stored by Google on your device. Google may be able to link these data or information with existing data.

The Digital Talent Academy offers young talents an education with a high practical share directly at Bosch.

The DTA first opened in January 2021. The objective: to train talented young people in a variety of digital skills. These range from intelligent process automation and artificial intelligence to data analysis and software development. “We saw how great the demand is for digital skills at Bosch,” explains Johnny Palma, who first came up with the idea for a digital talent factory. “So together with Henrique Dona, who is responsible for technical training in Campinas, I devised our own training program.” The DTA collaborates with the technical school SENAI (National Industrial Apprenticeship Service) in Campinas. The large theoretical part takes place at SENAI, while the technical and practical side happens at Bosch.

This dual-education model, which has a strong tradition in countries like Germany, is unique in Brazil. Here, assuming one has the financial means to do so, the traditional options are to study or to take part in an apprenticeship program. In Brazil, however, the latter is structured more like school and offers little in the way of practical experience.

Springboard to a better life

For many young Brazilians, the DTA is a springboard to a better life. “We do not selectively filter people by education, experience, or language skills beforehand. Everybody gets the same chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means,” says Gaston Diaz Perez, the head of Bosch in Latin America. “We want to make the program accessible for all talented, ambitious young people who share our values.” In this way, Bosch not only gets the country’s top talent, but is also living up to its social responsibility. “If you give them the opportunity to develop and have a better life, we can benefit on all levels — it’s a win for our business and for society,” says Diaz Perez.

Training in software development or artificial intelligence is not only an important step for Nicolly.

applied for admission to the program this year. Thirty-six of them started as apprentices in January 2023.

Nicolly is just one of many examples that prove that what matters most here is ability. “I was surprised they accepted me,” she admits. “Who takes on a young single mother?” When she applied, her daughter was just six months old. Nicolly’s mother was skeptical about whether she would be able to handle so many responsibilities, but she still encouraged her daughter to go for it. And Nicolly was a standout — in a three-stage selection procedure consisting of an IQ test, group work, and a face-to-face interview. “At the interview stage, we find out who has the potential and the determination to develop here,” says Henrique Dona. “Most students start out not speaking a word of English or knowing how to program. Today they’re presenting their project work to members of the Bosch board of management,” he says.

When Nicolly got one of the coveted apprenticeships out of 2,000 applications, her daughter was six months old. Her goal: she wants to her daughter a good future.

Between family life and programming

Mom and digital talent for smart automation — two vocations that Nicolly masters every day anew.

Nicolly lives with her parents, her three siblings, and her two-year-old daughter in Hortolândia, a small town near Campinas. In order to juggle both family and studies, her daily routine has to be well planned. Nicolly’s day therefore starts very early. She and her daughter get up at five o’clock. Shortly after six, she catches the company shuttle that takes her to the Bosch site. The trip itself takes about an hour. When the young Brazilian steps onto the company grounds, she’s no longer a single mother. Wearing her Bosch polo shirt as a school uniform, she’s a digital talent — one of 103 in the country. Bent over her laptop, she spends her time working with different programming languages and getting to grips with robotics and her specialist area of smart automation.

“Everybody gets the chance — regardless of their background, gender, or financial means.”

Nicolly’s focus in the training is intelligent process automation. Together with her fellow students, she enjoys everyday campus life and togetherness.

Now in her last semester, the 19-year-old is already working on her own projects in the Electrical Drives division. “At the moment, I’m looking at things like how Excel tables can be automated so that manual input is no longer necessary,” she explains. When she finishes her apprenticeship, there’s a good chance that she’ll be offered a permanent position in the division. All the graduates in the DTA’s first cohort received a job offer from Bosch. “I want to be able to offer my daughter a good future. My biggest wish is to buy my own apartment and car,” says Nicolly, when asked about her plans for the future. The battle for the best talent will then continue into the next round. The next group of 84 digital apprentices is already waiting in the wings for their start the following semester. “When looking to recruit the best software talent, Brazil should definitely be a port of call,” says Johnny Palma. “Our apprentices will do and develop things that we haven’t even dreamed of.”

title: Product Manager - Search
description:
About us

AB InBev is the leading global brewer and one of the world’s top 5 consumer product companies. With over 500 beer brands, we’re number one or two in many of the world’s top beer markets, including North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia, and Africa.

About AB InBev Growth Group

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery, and tabletop beer keg PerfectDraft.

We are an exceptional team, focused on understanding and supporting consumer and customer needs, harnessing new technology, and scaling growth opportunities.

About the role

We are looking for a Product Manager to lead the Search product within the BEES app. Search is a critical capability for BEES, powering most product findability flows and directly impacting GMV across multiple markets.

This role sits within the BEES Core team, responsible for building scalable, reliable, and reusable capabilities that serve multiple BEES platforms (Customer, Force, and Link).

You will work closely with engineering, data, design, and multiple product teams to evolve our search algorithms, infrastructure, and user experience, ensuring high performance, reliability, and relevance at scale.

What you'll do

  • Own the product strategy and execution for the Search domain, ensuring high availability, relevance, and performance across countries;
  • Act as a bridge between product and engineering, translating business needs into clear, well-defined epics, features, and technical requirements;
  • Lead backlog refinement, breaking down epics into actionable stories in collaboration with engineering teams;
  • Collaborate with multiple BEES product teams, as Search powers product lists with impacts across various value streams in the apps;
  • Closely monitor search performance and health metrics per country, proactively identifying and addressing issues;
  • Define and validate feature acceptance criteria, ensuring quality before production releases;
  • Leverage data to drive decisions, using existing dashboards and building new analyses when needed;
  • Drive the evolution of search capabilities, including relevance tuning, commercial indicators, and future AI and natural language search initiatives;
  • Collaborate with global stakeholders, presenting updates and insights to senior leadership.

What you'll need

  • University degree in a field related to the role;
  • Experience as a Product Manager working on technical, platform, or backend-heavy products, preferably in technology-driven companies;
  • Strong understanding of search systems, algorithms, or highly scalable backend services (hands‑on experience is a plus, but not mandatory);
  • Ability to comfortably communicate with engineers, understanding both backend and frontend concepts and trade-offs;
  • Experience working with data to analyze product performance, identify issues, and support decision‑making;
  • Experience working in cross‑functional and highly collaborative environments;
  • Familiarity with Agile product development practices;
  • Advanced English skills (written and spoken), with the ability to present and communicate with global stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Previous experience with search, ranking, personalization, or recommendation systems;
  • Exposure to cloud platforms (especially Azure);
  • Experience working on core or platform products that serve multiple applications or teams.

What We Offer

  • Attendance Bonus*
  • Casual office and dress code
  • Days off*
  • Health, dental, and life insurance
  • Discounts on Ambev products*
  • School materials assurance

About ABI GrowthGroup

Created in 2022, the Growth Group unifies our business-to-business (B2B), direct-to-consumer (DTC), Sales & Distribution, and Marketing teams. By bringing together global tech and commercial functions, the Growth Group allows us to fully leverage data and drive digital transformation and organic growth for AB InBev around the world.

In addition to supporting well-known global beer brands like Corona, Budweiser, and Michelob Ultra, the Growth Group is home to a robust suite of digital products including our B2B digital commerce platform BEES, on-demand delivery services Ze Delivery and TaDa Delivery.

What You’ll Do

As a Product Manager, you’ll play a pivotal role in driving the strategy, development, and delivery of impactful products and features. You’ll act as a bridge between stakeholders, customers, and technical teams to ensure that the product vision aligns with business goals and user needs.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Leading cross-functional teams, providing mentorship, and ensuring successful feature delivery.

  • Participating in technical discussions to understand system integrations, APIs, and databases.
  • Facilitating continuous improvement in team processes, leveraging tools like JIRA and Confluence.

What You’ll Need

Experience:

  • Experience in product management, with roles such as Product Manager, Product Owner, or Business Analyst.
  • Proven track record in managing medium-to-large projects with tight timelines.
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Kanban).
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.

Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a customer-centric mindset.
  • Proficiency with tools like JIRA, Confluence, and data analytics platforms.
  • Ability to write clear and actionable requirements, business cases, and user stories.
  • Technical understanding of APIs, databases, and system integrations; SQL knowledge is a plus.
  • Excellent communication skills to collaborate with diverse stakeholders.

Mindset:

  • Adaptability to shifting priorities and organizational changes.
  • Creative problem-solving skills with a focus on process and solution improvement.
  • Passionate about delivering high-quality solutions that impact millions of users.
  • Resilient and proactive, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Why Join Us?

  • Work with a talented, diverse team on products that make a global impact.
  • Enjoy opportunities for professional growth and mentorship.
  • Be part of a culture that values innovation, collaboration, and user-centered design.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package tailored to support your success.
